text: Think of your money like a car on a long road trip: right now you plan to start at 58 but the tank (savings and investments) looks like it will run dry at 85, leaving a gap before you reach 91. The plan says Social Security will cover 34% of your $89,649 yearly needs, so you and your partner can see that about $59,613 a year must come from your portfolio and that shortfall would be $32,439.
